messages:
morgan: FYI support escalated — external pen tester can't find audit evidence for an HSM-backed KMS rotation we supposedly performed on 2026-03-14. They also hit intermittent 500s when calling GetKeyMetadata. Customer demanding retest and severity re-eval.

samir: link the case id and the exact event IDs pls. any S3/glacier lifecycle changes recently?

morgan: CASE# 2026-03-14-4532. Pen notes: tried to fetch rotation event for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01, timeframe 2026-03-14T10:00–10:30Z. Support logs show some 500s at 10:11:xx. Attached their query log snippet: 
```
GET /kms/metadata?KeyId=abcd-ef01  200
POST /kms/rotate  202
GET /cloudtrail/events?eventId=evt-xyz   404
GET /kms/metadata?KeyId=abcd-ef01  500
```

support-bot: automated note: case opened, priority P1 (customer escalation). Assigned to eng-security.

lee: I can check CloudTrail and S3 objects. Which bucket did we push audit bundles to for HSM events?

morgan: redwood-audit-usw2, path: audits/keys/2026/03/14/. Pen says object for key rotation missing.

alex: we rolled a lifecycle rule on redwood-audit-usw2 two weeks ago to transition older objects to GLACIER DEEP ARCHIVE and then expire after 30 days — was that applied to the audits prefix?

morgan: here's the lifecycle config we applied earlier this month: 
```
{
  "Rules": [
    {"ID":"audit-transition","Filter":{"Prefix":"audits/"},"Status":"Enabled","Transitions":[{"Days":5,"StorageClass":"GLACIER"}],"Expiration":{"Days":35}}
  ]
}
```

samir: oh — 5 days transition is aggressive. If the object transitioned to GLACIER it might be inaccessible for immediate head/get without restore. That would explain 404/500 from the pen. Need to check if object exists in Glacier and whether a restore was attempted.

jordan: also check CloudTrail logs for KMS and any HSM vendor logs (HSM appliance pushes). We mirror HSM audit to internal-archive with a 24h lag. If pen tested within 1h of rotation, internal mirror might not have arrived.

sec-bot: KMS rotation event recorded internally: EventId=evt-20260314-101205, KeyId=abcd-ef01, Actor=system-scheduled-rotation, Timestamp=2026-03-14T10:12:05Z. Entry replicated to internal-archive at 2026-03-14T11:43:02Z.

diana-pen: I pulled CloudTrail for the window and got no rotation event for that KeyId in the customer-visible trail. We also couldn't retrieve the audit bundle from redwood-audit-usw2/audits/keys/2026/03/14/abcd-ef01.json — return code was 404. From my perspective this looks like missing customer-facing evidence during the test window. This is why I labeled it high.

lee: confirmation: the internal logs show rotation. External trail probably didn't have the object yet due to our mirror delays + lifecycle transition to GLACIER. So it's a timing + lifecycle configuration gap rather than actual failure.

morgan: ok need a concrete remediation + retest plan and an evidence bundle to give the pen tester + customer. Proposed deliverables: 1) signed audit bundle (CloudTrail event, internal KMS/HSM log, object metadata including S3 version and storage class, restore status if any) 2) timeline showing mirror delay 3) statement about lifecycle change and plan to mitigate.

alex: I can generate a signed bundle. Steps I'll run: 
1) CloudTrail lookup for EventId: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventId,AttributeValue=evt-20260314-101205
```
2) S3 head-object to show storage class and version: 
```
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-audit-usw2 --key "audits/keys/2026/03/14/abcd-ef01.json"
# if archived, expect 404 or a response with "StorageClass": "GLACIER"
```
3) internal-archive pull: `scp archive:/hsm/logs/2026/03/14/hsm-abcd-ef01.log .`
4) bundle + gpg sign + upload to secure-share.

samir: add Legal/Compliance to review the attestation language before we send externally. Also we should decide severity now: I'd mark it SEVERITY: Medium (evidence temporarily unavailable externally; audit exists internally; config issue caused gap). We can bump to High if retest fails.

diana-pen: I'm fine with a retest and receiving the signed bundle. Want the retest scheduled within 48h. I'll target 2026-03-17 09:00–11:00 PT. Please confirm.

morgan: scheduled tentative retest for 2026-03-17 09:30 PT. alex, can you produce the bundle and post by EOD 2026-03-15 so Diana can validate before retest? We also need a short doc explaining the lifecycle rule rationale and rollback options.

alex: yep. I'll run the commands, if object is GLACIER I'll kick off an expedited restore and include restore job id in the bundle. Example restore command I'll use: 
```
aws s3api restore-object --bucket redwood-audit-usw2 --key "audits/keys/2026/03/14/abcd-ef01.json" --restore-request Days=7,GlacierJobParameters={Tier=Standard}
```

sec-bot: Reminder: any signed bundle shared externally must be logged to evidence-tracker and retained per compliance policy.

morgan: noted. Assigning action items: alex=produce signed bundle + initiate restore if needed. lee=validate CloudTrail parity and timestamp mapping. samir=prep severity note for incident tracker. jordan=confirm internal-archive replication schedule and why mirror laged 1h30m. sec-bot/Legal looped for attestation language.

diana-pen: thanks, will validate bundle and confirm retest slot. If quick restore works I'll rerun my checks during retest window.

morgan: closing loop for now. Next update when Alex posts the bundle. :thumbsup:
